candidates.title: Bitrig Hacks: iPhone Duo Edition
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
Bitrig
Bitrig Hacks: iPhone Duo Edition
Saturday, September 26
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 200
About Event
# Bitrig Hacks: iPhone Duo Edition

Join us for an afternoon of building for iPhone Duo, Apple's first foldable iPhone.

We're bringing together Apple developers, designers, founders, and students to explore what clever things can be built to take advantage of the new device.

The goal is to find something newly possible and make it real enough to demo. This could mean building a new app or adding a new feature to an existing app.

Lunch, snacks, prizes, and great company included.

Hosted by Bitrig ([bitrig.com](http://bitrig.com)) (S25). Sponsored by Y Combinator, OpenAI, RevenueCat, Sentry, and Supabase.

### September 26, 2026 · YC Office · San Francisco, CA

### Eligibility

Participate solo or with a team. We recommend working in groups, and we're happy to help you form a team if you're coming on your own.

This is an in-person event in San Francisco. You must be able to attend on-site to participate.

Attendees must be 16 or older.

### Schedule

September 26

10:30 AM: Doors Open & Check-In
11:00 AM: Opening Ceremony
11:30 AM – 3:30 PM: Hacking
1:00 PM: Lunch
3:30 PM – 5:00 PM: Demos & Judging
5:00 PM – 6:00 PM: Awards & Mingling

### What to Build

Projects should use Apple's newly released APIs for iPhone Duo to build something that would not have been as compelling, or even possible, before.

Entries do not need to be complete end-to-end apps. A polished demo is enough.

iPhone Duo doesn't ship until October 23, so we'll be building with the iPhone Duo simulator in the Xcode 27.1 beta. We're also adding some special iPhone Duo support to Bitrig for the occasion.

Participants are encouraged to brainstorm project ideas before the event. Apple's iPhone Duo developer page ([developer.apple.com/iphone-duo/](http://developer.apple.com/iphone-duo/)) is a great place to start.

### Rules

All code must be created at the hackathon.

Preparing design assets ahead of time is fine.

Participants are not required to use Bitrig, but there will be a prize for the best project created in Bitrig.

### Judging

The top entries will demo live at the end of the event, and judges will select winners from those demos.

Judges will look for projects that make creative, thoughtful use of iPhone Duo's new APIs and show something meaningfully new.

#### The judges will be:

 [Brad Flora](https://x.com/bradflora), General Partner at Y Combinator.
 [Kyle Macomber](https://x.com/kylemacomber), co-founder and CEO of Bitrig. Co-creator of SwiftUI at Apple.
 [Justin Santamaria](https://x.com/jsmaria), co-founder and CTO of Future. Early member of the iPhone team at Apple.
 [Yuma Soerianto](https://x.com/yumaSoerianto), 5x WWDC Swift Student Challenge winner, Rise Global Winner, coding educator, indie developer, and robotics startup founder.
 [Jane Manchun Wong](https://x.com/wongmjane), security researcher and reverse engineer known for uncovering unreleased features in major apps.
 More judges will be announced soon!

### Prizes

Prizes for winning entries include:

 A new iPhone
 A $500 Apple gift card
 A guaranteed interview with Y Combinator
 OpenAI credits
 Supabase credits

#### All participants will also receive:

 OpenAI credits
 Sentry credits
 Supabase credits
 1 month of free Bitrig
 Bitrig swag

candidates.title: Own Your Intelligence Hackathon
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
River AI
Own Your Intelligence Hackathon
Sunday, September 27
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 225
About Event
Hosted by River AI, GBrain, Memorable, QM, Superset, and UFO, this hackathon is a day for building at the frontier of AI-native software.

Participants will explore new ways to extend QM and GBrain, build novel agent workflows and interfaces, experiment with multiplayer and software-factory ideas, and use River AI, Memorable, Superset and UFO to push beyond what today’s tools make easy. The goal is to make something ambitious, useful, or unexpected.

River AI: <https://river.ai>

GBrain: <https://gbrain.io/>

Memorable: <https://www.memorable.sh/>

QM: [https://qm.ycombinator.com](https://qm.ycombinator.com/)

Superset: <https://superset.sh/>

UFO: <https://ufo.ai>

Hackathon agenda

12:00 PM — Doors open + lunch
1:00 PM — Opening remarks
1:15 PM — Hacking begins
5:00 PM — Hacking ends + projects due
5:00–5:45 PM — Judging
6:00 PM — Prizes + closing remarks

candidates.title: Make Something Agents Want
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
YC
Make Something Agents Want Hackathon
Saturday, October 17
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 225
About Event
Y Combinator’s motto has always been “make something people want.” It’s increasingly “make something agents want.”

Bot and agent traffic on the web now is greater than human traffic. If you’re running a dev tools company, ecommerce store, or even a website, you are increasingly thinking about building for agents.

Building for agents is different. Agent experience (AX) rather than user experience (UX). Headless MCPs, rather than UIs and APIs. Optimizing token spend rather than minimizing user time. Documentation made for agents rather than humans.

If you’re an exceptional builder who wants to create for the future of agents as the user, join us at the _Make Something Agents Want Hackathon_ hosted by YC teams building for agents.

Sponsors: [Armature](https://armature.tech/), [Blaxel](https://blaxel.ai/), [Inkbox](https://inkbox.ai/), [Insforge](https://insforge.dev/), [Manufact](https://manufact.com/), [Primitive](https://primitive.dev), [Stripe](https://stripe.com/)

Schedule | October 17, 2026

 9 AM - Doors open and Sign In
 10 AM - Kickoff
 10:30 AM - Hacking Begins
 12:00 PM - Lunch
 12:15 PM - Lunch Lightning Talks
 5:00 PM - Dinner
 6:00 PM - Dinner Lightning Talks

October 18, 2026

 8:00 AM - Breakfast
 10:00 AM - Submissions Due + Live Demos
 11:00 AM - Judging Completes
 12:00 PM - Lunch
 12:15 PM - Winners Announced
 1:00 PM - Hackathon Ends

Prize Track:

Manufact: Best MCP Server for Agents

1st: $1k cash, $1k Manufact credits, Teenage Engineering products for each team member

2nd: $500 cash, $500 Manufact credits

3rd: $300 cash, $300 Manufact credits

_Judges_: [Luigi Pederzani](mailto:luigi@manufact.com), Pietro Zullo, Enrico Toniato

Insforge: Agent-Native Cloud

1st: $1,000 cash (Visa giftcard) , $1,000 cloud credits

2nd: $500 cash (Visa giftcard) , $500 cloud credits

3rd: $300 cash (Visa giftcard) , $300 cloud credits

_Judges_:  [Tony Chang](mailto:tony.chang@insforge.dev) [Hang Huang](mailto:hang.huang@insforge.dev)

Armature: Best Agent Experience (AX):

Winner: $1,000 cash, $1,000 Armature credits

Runner-up: $500 cash, $500 Armature credits

Third: $300 cash, $300 Armature credits

Description: Agents can use your product through a dedicated Agent-Facing Interface (MCP, CLI). Build the best experience for them!

Judges: [Theodore Otzenberger](mailto:theodore@armature.tech), Louis Scremin

Best Primitive Integration

$5k

Blaxel: Something a Human Would Never Want

_Coming shortly_

Inkbox 

_Interesting projects giving agents a persistent identity with email, phone, iMessage, and A2A, so they can communicate with humans and each other_

1st place: $1,000 in Inkbox credits

2nd place: $500 in Inkbox credits

3rd place: $200 in Inkbox credits

Stripe

_Coming shortly_
